body: RBI press release (prid 64032): Governor met MDs/CEOs of select NBFCs (incl. govt NBFCs), HFCs and MFIs, with Sa-Dhan, MFIN, FIDC; DGs present. Emphasised responsible and sustainable credit growth, customer-first, grievance redressal, fair recovery practices, CKYCR use, cybersecurity. Release does not mention 'microfinance stress', gold loans or 'reckless growth' (headline framing). SFBs not in this meeting. Sector context for Utkarsh SFB (L41); neutral.
title: RBI Governor meets NBFC, HFC and MFI heads (23-Nov-2026): responsible credit growth, fair recovery, cybersecurity; no new directive
